direction:card.rationale:
WHAT IT IS. This is a self-contained mockup of the "card" direction (434,761 bytes). It builds on the card mockup an earlier run left in the same folder; it is an extension, not a rebuild. A Literary devices card sits beside the Layers card at Study and Deep, with the same frame and its own violet, the colour its arcs take on the map. Each entry on the selected verse has five parts: the BSB words, with the answering words in the app's colour pairs; one plain line; the Hebrew the English hides; its sources; and a "see the whole structure" view. That view uses the map's own visual language: nested arcs for a mirror, interlocking arcs for an alternation, two columns for a foil, and violet device arcs on the big map. The page uses the tokens and fonts from web/src/styles.css, in the Paper and Sky themes. It has Simple, Study and Deep switches and a Desktop or Phone (390 px) frame. A "card at each level" strip shows all three levels side by side.

THE EXAMPLES:
- Psalm 1:6: opposite lines, and the whole psalm's two ways (3 and 4 writers).
- Psalm 19:1-2: the same thought said twice (Calvin, Keil and Delitzsch), the sky spoken of as a person, and Bullinger's four-part layout. Because only he gives the layout, it shows only at Deep, labelled "a structure some readers see".
- Isaiah 6:10: the chiasm. It passed the research's first tier (a word mirror inside one verse, checked in the Hebrew) and is widely agreed: Bullinger p. 299, Jamieson-Fausset-Brown, and Keil and Delitzsch.
- Genesis 6:6: "God's sorrow told in human words". Seven writers name it, and the card gives both believing readings, each with its writers. The view lays nacham across Genesis 6:7, Numbers 23:19 and 1 Samuel 15.
- 1 Samuel 1:2: Hannah and Peninnah set side by side (Bullinger, Henry, Keil and Delitzsch), plus the crossing of the names.
- 1 Samuel 15:29: beside the live Layers card.
Every Scripture string is BSB, copied from the pinned BSB.json and checked by script: 70 strings. All 36 writers' quotations were matched against each writer's own text.

THE FOUNDER'S ANSWER APPLIED ("just credit original source ... no crediting of ai"):
- Nothing in the page credits AI or the app. The build now fails if "AI help", "Claude" or "reviewed by a person" appears anywhere in it.
- Original sources are named at every level:
  - Simple: the quiet line under the verse carries the writers' names, for example "Named by Matthew Henry, Keil and Delitzsch and John Gill".
  - Study: each entry ends with its sources. Each writer's name links to his page on that verse. The device itself is defined in the words of the book that defines it, linked to its printed page.
  - Deep: adds each writer's own words, Bullinger's old name for the form, the Sources line and "Suggest a correction".
- The Layers card is shown with the matching proposed change. Its notes name their writers at every level, and its live line "Drafted with AI help (Claude) from ..." becomes "Drawn from ...".

DEFINITIONS FROM A TRUSTED DEFINING SOURCE. This applies your theme point (point 14) to devices. Every form is defined in Bullinger's own sentence from Figures of Speech (1898, public domain): pages 349, 351, 299, 356, 365, 861 and 871.
- Each sentence is checked word for word in the e-text and on its printed page of the Princeton scan on archive.org (figuresofspeechu00bull).
- The page numbers come from archive.org's own page map and BookReader data, both fetched today. Page 351 is leaf 405, so each "p." link opens the right page.
- As a negative test, the same quotation scores 0 to 15% on the wrong pages.
- Bullinger's verse-level claims also link to their page: Genesis 6:6 p. 882, Isaiah 6:10 p. 299, 1 Samuel 1:2 p. 357, Psalm 19 p. 366, Psalm 19:1 p. 865.
- Where no book of figures from 1930 or earlier names the device (character pairs), the card says so and rests the pair on its writers.

CONFLICTS TO FLAG:
- CLAUDE.md on main says "Disclose AI drafting. Every AI-drafted passage and card says 'Drafted with AI help (Claude) ...'". The live Layers source lines say the same on all 1,264 passages. Both now conflict with your answer. The mockup follows your answer, but the clone is read-only, so CLAUDE.md and config/layers.json are unchanged; changing them needs its own PR.
- Main is now b6d7f1e, not 75f6edc. The three new commits are docs only (CLAUDE.md and docs/HANDOFF.md).
- I could not tell what "FOR 10" refers to, so nothing here acts on it.

FILES (all under ...\scratchpad\ba\literary):
- mock-tools\credits.src.json: definitions and pages
- mock-tools\mock-card.template.html
- mock-tools\build_mock.py: adds the definition, page and no-AI checks
- mock-tools\devices.src.json: example notes updated
- the earlier run's versions, kept as *.before-credits.* (including mock-card.before-credits.html)
- scan files in mock-dl\ia\
- screenshots in shots\cr-*.png: Psalm 1 at Simple and Study (Sky), Psalm 1 at Deep (Paper), Isaiah 6 with its view open (Paper), Genesis 6 at Deep with its view open, Hannah at Study, 1 Samuel 15:29, Psalm 19 at Deep, and the page checked in three 375 px iframes, light and dark, with no sideways scroll.

QUESTIONS FOR THE FOUNDER:
- May Keach and De Laune's Tropologia (1681, CC0, already on GitHub) be a second definer beside Bullinger?
- The research's open questions still stand: Bullinger as the backbone, single-writer structures, and violet versus gold.
